summary: BASTION_ENABLED=false smoke test — call served by Sera but no session ingested by Bastion, as expected. Confirms the kill-switch is wired and decoupled from the audio path; if Bastion were to lose backend, Sera would keep answering calls and only the observability layer would degrade. Why: HIPAA §164.312(c)(2) integrity controls require pharmacy operations to continue independently of monitoring infrastructure.
